description: Report a freehire operation you could not complete, a missing capability, or unexpected behavior for the team to triage. Give concise summaries of the user's goal, expected result, and actual failure. Include a tool name and error code when known. Do not include conversations, CV contents, credentials, tokens, personal contact details, or URL query strings. A successful receipt means the report was recorded for review; it does not mean the issue is fixed or that a reply is guaranteed. Repeated matching open reports for this account increase request_count. Use only for a problem met while doing what the user asked, and for a missing capability only when the user asked for it. Never file a test, sample or demonstration report: this tool needs no trial run. Never report a failure of report_problem itself recursively.

actual.description: Observed failure, 1 to 2000 characters after trimming. Summarize errors without sensitive payloads.

error_code.description: Optional error code identifier, up to 80 characters.

expected.description: Expected result, 1 to 1000 characters after trimming.

goal.description: Intended goal, 1 to 500 characters after trimming.

tool_name.description: Optional tool identifier, up to 80 letters, digits, underscores, dots, colons or hyphens.

name: report_problem
title: Report an operation problem
